name: Kokoro read-aloud
author: Sayed Qutob
description: Select text anywhere, press a hotkey, hear it read aloud with Kokoro TTS, locally. The bar widget sets it up on first use, frees the model's VRAM, switches between GPU and CPU, and shows the sentence being read.

barWidget.description: Free the TTS model's VRAM for games and AI work, run it on the CPU instead, restart it, and watch the sentence being read.
